Name: Tychicus
Summary: Tychicus was an Asian companion of Paul who travelled with him toward Jerusalem, and later carried Paul's letters to the churches, a beloved brother and faithful minister.
KeyStory: Tychicus travelled with Paul toward Jerusalem and later carried his letters to the churches he loved.
LifeLesson: Messengers carry more than paper. Tychicus carried Paul's heart to churches he could not visit.
